Ритансерин C27H25F2N3OS = 477.6. CAS — 87051-43-2. Profile Ritanserin is a serotonin antagonist that has been studied in a va- riety of disorders including anxiety disorders, depression, and schizophrenia. It is reported to have little sedative action. Action. Ritanserin is a relatively selective antagonist at seroton- in (5-hydroxytryptamine, 5-HT) receptors of the 5-HT2 subtype, although it also has appreciable affinity for 5-HT1C receptors.1 Unlike ketanserin (p.1320), it does not block α1-adrenergic re- cep
